sources.en_wiki: Black Clover Wiki (blackclover.fandom.com) pages Inverse Release, Closed Sorrow and Eternal Prison, read through search summaries only (host unreachable): Inverse Release unseals (forces a closed gateway, a sealed soul or magical bindings open), Closed Sorrow is a sealing-based healing spell that closes wounds, Eternal Prison is a forbidden sealing spell (a clear cube around the target).
sources.ja_search: Japanese pages found by search (manga-legend, manga-comic-netabare, the official site): 封緘魔法 (open and close), she freed the elf Licht from his seal, a forbidden art used against a devil.
sources.owner: The owner's own specification of Secre's four exclusive spells (docs/owner_specs/sealing_secre_spec.md): Branching Array (Mana Method), Eternal Prison, Wound Sealing, Orbital Bind.
sources.design: Order of acquisition decided by this mod from the arcs: see docs/magic/character_spells_bulls.md.

spells.name: Seal Magic: Seal
spells.note: Mode 0 of the Sealing book, so it stays in the basic book too.

spells.name: Seal Magic: Closed Sorrow (Wound Sealing)
spells.note: The wiki's name is Closed Sorrow; the mod's page is called Wound Sealing (the owner's name). It closes wounds instead of healing them. Already locked to her grimoire.

spells.name: Seal Magic: Inverse Release
spells.note: NEW page: the unsealing spell she used to give Licht back his power. Frees allies of binds and a sealed grimoire.

spells.name: Seal Magic: Branching Array (Mana Method)
spells.note: The owner's spell: a web of sealing lines that locks or unlocks an area. Already locked to her grimoire.

spells.name: Seal Magic: Orbital Bind
spells.note: The owner's spell: rings that orbit an ally as a lingering ward. Already locked to her grimoire.

spells.name: Seal Magic: Eternal Prison
spells.note: A forbidden spell that could hold a target for centuries. Already locked to her grimoire.

spells.name: Seal Magic: Sealing Stamp
spells.note: NEW shared page (Pages-15): a small seal thrown at a foe; the basic Seal Magic of her grimoire.

spells.name: Seal Magic: Sealing Needles
spells.note: NEW shared page (Pages-15): homing needles that cut a foe's casting.

spells.name: Seal Magic: Ward Mark
spells.note: NEW shared page (Pages-15): she seals a ward on herself and breaks a seal laid on her.

spells.name: Seal Magic: Closing Gate
spells.note: NEW shared page (Pages-15): the attribute opens and closes things; this page closes (Inverse Release opens).

spells.name: Seal Magic: Rune Lattice
spells.note: NEW shared page (Pages-15): a cone of runes that slows and jams.

spells.name: Seal Magic: Protective Seal
spells.note: NEW shared page (Pages-15): a ward seal on her allies.

spells.name: Seal Magic: Sigil Field
spells.note: NEW shared page (Pages-15): a field of sigils.

spells.name: Seal Magic: Forbidden Seal Art
spells.note: NEW shared page (Pages-15): the forbidden art she used against the devil (the manga gives it no name; the page name is the mod's). Opens only after Eternal Prison.

planned.name: Forbidden Art against the devil (the black horns)
planned.note: The act that turned her into the bird Nero for 500 years; no spell name.

notes: Not in Secre's grimoire (kept in the basic Sealing book): Grand Seal, Sealing Chains, Trinity Seal Magic (a compound spell of other mages), Seal Barrier, the Sigil Combo (the basic seal's random combo), Sigil Burst and Pillars of Seal. Pages-15 added eight shared pages to her set so her grimoire shows 15.
